Projects at GLOARO

Selected work from my product design internship at GLOARO (Aug – Nov 2026). Each project showcases end-to-end UX thinking, visual design, and interface execution across different product categories.

Project 01 — Admin Dashboard & Mobile App
Delivery Partner App
Product Designer & UX Designer · GLOARO

Designed a dual-interface system comprising an admin dashboard and a delivery partner mobile application. The admin side provides real-time order dispatching, delivery agent management, and performance analytics. The delivery partner app offers an intuitive flow for order acceptance, live route guidance, and status updates — optimised for fast-paced, on-the-go use.

Project 02 — EdTech · Web Application
Smart School Management System
Product Designer & UX Designer · GLOARO

Conceived and designed an automated school management system to digitalise core institutional workflows. The product unifies student enrolment, attendance tracking, timetable management, teacher assignments, and academic progress reporting into a single, cohesive interface — reducing administrative overhead and improving clarity for staff, students, and parents.

Web App Information Architecture Wireframing Prototyping Figma
Project 03 — Website Design · Landing Page
Premium CBSE School Website
Visual Designer & UI Designer · GLOARO

Designed a premium, trust-led landing page for a CBSE-affiliated school targeting parents and prospective students. The design balances institutional authority with approachability — using a structured content hierarchy, clean typography, and thoughtful visual language to highlight academic programmes, faculty, facilities, and admissions. Fully responsive across desktop and mobile viewports.

Landing Page Visual Design Responsive Design Colour Theory Figma
Project 04 — E-commerce · Landing Page
GLOARO Mart
UI Designer & Visual Designer · GLOARO

Designed the landing page for GLOARO's grocery e-commerce vertical. The experience focuses on fast product discovery, category-first navigation, and a conversion-optimised layout. The visual design communicates freshness and ease, with a clean product card system, prominent promotional areas, and a seamless browsing-to-checkout entry point designed for both desktop and mobile users.
